findings.correction: It wasn’t as if I’d shaken only one or two hands while trying to raise my Fame. He was probably one of them.
findings.current:
How many hands had I shaken while trying to raise my Fame? One or two?

He was probably one of them.
findings.defect: 한 둘이냐 is a rhetorical denial: the hands shaken were many, not one or two. The English reads as if the number might actually be one or two.
findings.rationale: The idiom marks quantity as more than a couple; rendering it as “One or two?” reverses that count and the joke that Gwak Jun was lost in a crowd of Fame handshakes.
findings.source: 명성치 올리려고 잡은 손이 한 둘이냐. 아마 그들 중 하나였겠지.

findings.correction: It seems the enemy reinforcements crossed Mount Otae two days ago.
findings.current: It seems the enemy reinforcements crossed Mount Ota two days ago.
findings.defect: 오태산 romanizes as Otae, not Ota. The place name is wrong.
findings.rationale: 오태 is Otae; Ota would be 오타. An unlisted toponym still has to match the syllables on the page.
findings.source: 이틀 전 적들의 원군이 오태산을 넘었다는군.

findings.defect: 허어 is impressed astonishment, not a request for clarification or a confused “What?”
findings.rationale: The Head Elder’s first spoken reaction to the hidden bows is wonder; the tent’s uproar and Taekyung’s dropped jaw follow that beat, not puzzlement.

findings.correction: The tent grew hot beneath the fervent gazes of those swarthy men.
findings.current: The tent grew hot beneath the fervent gazes of the dark-clad men.
findings.defect: 시커먼 describes the men as swarthy/dark-looking, not dressed in dark clothes. Clothing color is not in the source.
findings.rationale: Black martial robes are specified later for Gwak Jun’s group. Calling the council “dark-clad” adds a costume fact the Korean does not give.
findings.source: 시커먼 사내놈들의 뜨거운 시선에 막사가 후끈 달아오른다.

findings.correction: three hundred martial artists from the Jin Family of Taiyuan and one hundred fifty reinforcements from the small and mid-sized sects—four hundred fifty in all—departed for the gorge.
findings.current: three hundred martial artists from the Jin Family of Taiyuan and one hundred fifty reinforcements from the small and mid-sized sects departed for the gorge.
findings.defect: The explicit total of four hundred fifty is omitted.
findings.rationale: 삼백 and 백오십 remain, but 도합 사백오십 is a stated headcount, not just arithmetic the reader is left to do.
findings.source: 태원진가의 무사 삼백과 중소 문파의 지원군 백오십. 도합 사백오십의 병력이 협곡을 향해 떠났다.

findings.current: They had nearly twice our numbers
findings.defect: 달하는 is “amounting to twice,” not “nearly twice.”
findings.rationale: The hedge changes the force ratio Jin Taekyung uses to explain why the enemy will choose a clash.

summary: One reversed quantity in the handshake aside, plus a wrong mountain romanization and two reaction/description shifts that change astonishment and clothing.
